about.headline: From Telecom to frontend
about.intro: I started out in Telecommunications, but at some point I realized that what I really wanted was to build things people use every day on their devices, so I made the move to web development. Since then I've worked with Angular on challenging projects —with Exolum, El Corte Inglés and BMW, among others— specializing in the work I truly enjoy.
about.closing: It's not enough for me that something "works": I care about code that's maintainable and an experience that feels right.

experience.headline: My journey
experience.description: Over four years building interfaces, from WordPress sites to Angular micro-frontend architectures.
